programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max decides to confront Roberto, and gives in to Astrid's seduction, but not out of love but out of spite. During a family dinner, Ezequiel toasts Octavia, but expresses his intention to marry another woman. Camila knows that her mother will return.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila does not understand why her mother returns to take revenge and the reason for so much hatred. Mother Isabel, Father Tiziano and Elda, keep an accomplice silence. Max confronts Roberto and Camila reacts with jealousy and rage.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila lies about her relationship with Roberto. Max is very beaten and this situation is taken advantage of by Astrid who comes on to him a lot, but he rejects her. Ezequiel humiliates and mistreats Leandro, his sick son.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila tells Max the whole truth and confesses that she loves him, however, in a new encounter she asks him to trust her while she tries to solve the matter that torments them so much. Roberto is determined to kill Max.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roberto asks Astrid to get him a job at Mascarada in exchange for not doing anything against Max. Camila confesses to Max that Roberto is blackmailing her. Luciano and the inspector question Mother Isabel and Father Tiziano about Rosa Blanco and they lie.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Mother Isabel defends Camila from Roberto's accusation and confronts Camila. Max, finding her very sad, asks her to trust him. Julia and Gregorio come up with a plan to make their parents think they will never see each other again and stop following them.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila fiercely defends herself from Roberto's aggression and tells Max what happened. Mother Isabel, to help Camila, confides to Ezequiel why Roberto is extorting her. Max pressures Camila to tell him the whole truth.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roberto confesses that he was the one who killed Gabriel to frame Camila. Camila cries with joy, knowing she is innocent of that death. Max reiterates his unconditional support, ratifying his great love for her. Ezequiel expresses his intention to marry Camila.
